\chapter{Show Me, Help Me}
\label{ch:ml-show-me-help-me}
\hlchaptermodality{120}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can ask someone to show me or help me, ask them to stop, and say I did not hear or did not understand.}

Complete the last lesson of chapter 120: i can ask someone to show me or help me, ask them to stop, and say I did not hear or did not understand.

\section[kāṇikkū]{\ml{കാണിക്കൂ} (kāṇikkū) — please show}

\label{lesson:ML-C120-show}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for meaning, then the Malayalam for please wait.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{കാണിക്കൂ}}
\textbf{\ml{കാണിക്കൂ}} (\emph{kāṇikkū}) — \textquotedblleft{}please show (me)\textquotedblright{}, from \textbf{\ml{കാണുക}} (\emph{kāṇuka}), \textquotedblleft{}to see\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
To see, turned into to show.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kāṇikkū}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kāṇikkū}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{kāṇikkū}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for meaning, then the Malayalam for please wait, then say \emph{kāṇikkū} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{കാണിക്കൂ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Please show\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[kēṭṭilla]{\ml{കേട്ടില്ല} (kēṭṭilla) — I didn't hear}

\label{lesson:ML-C120-didnthear}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for please wait, then the Malayalam for please show.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{കേട്ടില്ല}}
\textbf{\ml{കേട്ടില്ല}} (\emph{kēṭṭilla}) — \textquotedblleft{}(I) didn't hear\textquotedblright{}, \textbf{\ml{കേട്ടു}}, \textquotedblleft{}heard\textquotedblright{}, with \textbf{\ml{ഇല്ല}}, \textquotedblleft{}not\textquotedblright{}. Follow it with \textbf{\ml{ഒന്നുകൂടി} \ml{പറയൂ}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Heard, and the no that follows.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kēṭṭilla}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kēṭṭilla}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{kēṭṭilla, onnukūṭi paṟayū}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for please wait, then the Malayalam for please show, then say \emph{kēṭṭilla} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{കേട്ടില്ല} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}I didn't hear\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[manassilāyilla]{\ml{മനസ്സിലായില്ല} (manassilāyilla) — I didn't understand}

\label{lesson:ML-C120-didntunderstand}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for please show, then the Malayalam for I didn't hear.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{മനസ്സിലായില്ല}}
\textbf{\ml{മനസ്സിലായില്ല}} (\emph{manassilāyilla}) — \textquotedblleft{}I didn't understand\textquotedblright{}, literally \textquotedblleft{}it didn't come into the mind\textquotedblright{}: \textbf{\ml{മനസ്സ്}} (\emph{manassŭ}), \textquotedblleft{}mind\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Mind, and the no that closes it.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{manassilāyilla}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{manassilāyilla}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{manassilāyilla, patukke paṟayū}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for please show, then the Malayalam for I didn't hear, then say \emph{manassilāyilla} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{മനസ്സിലായില്ല} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}I didn't understand\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[nirttū]{\ml{നിർത്തൂ} (nirttū) — please stop}

\label{lesson:ML-C120-stop}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for I didn't understand, then the Malayalam for please help.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{നിർത്തൂ}}
\textbf{\ml{നിർത്തൂ}} (\emph{nirttū}) — \textquotedblleft{}please stop (it)\textquotedblright{}, said to a driver or about a noise. \textbf{\ml{ഇവിടെ} \ml{നിർത്തൂ}} — \textquotedblleft{}please stop here\textquotedblright{}, with \textbf{\ml{ഇവിടെ}}, \textquotedblleft{}here\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The request in a taxi.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nirttū}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nirttū}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{iviṭe nirttū}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for I didn't understand, then the Malayalam for please help, then say \emph{nirttū} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{നിർത്തൂ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Please stop\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
